newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 futures end sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 futures end sharply higher.

text.p: May 9 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures ended sharply higher in line with T-bond futures closing tone. But traders called afternoon activity quiet, said many await next week's inflation data and May 20 FOMC. One broker said range from 810.00 to 840.00 likely to confine market into FOMC. Nikkei ends lower in sympathy with sagging dollar, trader said.
